pages.title: Emap2lig Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to Emap2lig: what it does, the two-stage pipeline (Find + Build), supported interfaces, and links to all major sections.

pages.title: Getting Started & Installation
pages.purpose: Step-by-step installation instructions for CLI-only and full repository setups, hardware requirements, and first-run model weight download.

pages.title: Supported Platforms & Hardware
pages.purpose: Details on Linux/CUDA and macOS/MPS accelerator support, version requirements, and fallback to the KiharaLab web server when no local GPU is available.

pages.title: Pipeline Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of the end-to-end two-stage inference pipeline: data flow from cryo-EM map input through Find (segmentation) and Build (diffusion modeling) to mmCIF output. Links to child pages for each stage.

pages.title: Map Preprocessing & Normalization
pages.purpose: How raw cryo-EM maps are resampled to 1.0 Å/voxel, normalized using EMDB contour levels, cropped to content, and serialized as MapObject/DensityObject.

pages.title: Data Types & Serialization
pages.purpose: Core data structures used throughout the pipeline: MapObject, DensityObject, LigandObject, LigandRecord, Atom/Bond structured arrays, and NumpySerializable NPZ I/O.

pages.title: Chemical Component Dictionary (CCD)
pages.purpose: How ligand molecular templates are resolved: bulk HuggingFace dictionary, per-CCD pickle cache, RCSB CIF fallback, ETKDG 3D conformer generation, and the get_ccd_mol / get_conformer_from_smiles API.

pages.title: Stage 1 — Find: Ligand Blob Detection
pages.purpose: How the MUNetRegSeg model performs sliding-window segmentation of cryo-EM maps to produce per-class probability maps and isolated ligand density blobs (DensityObject NPZ files).

pages.title: MUNet Segmentation Model
pages.purpose: Architecture of MUNetRegSeg and FragmentRegSeg: MUNetBackbone, SegHead, RegHead, sliding-window inference, and Li-threshold binarization.

pages.title: Stage 2 — Build: Diffusion-Based Structure Modeling
pages.purpose: How the Emap2lig LightningModule combines ConformerEmbedder, PairFormer, InstanceSegModule, and AtomDiffusion to generate 3D atomic coordinates for each detected blob.

pages.title: PairFormer & Attention Layers
pages.purpose: Detailed description of PairFormerBlock, TriangleAttention (starting/ending node), TriangleMultiplication, OuterProductMean, AttentionPairBias, and their cuequivariance-optimized kernel paths.

pages.title: AtomDiffusion & Conditioning Modules
pages.purpose: EDM-style diffusion sampling: DiffusionModule, AtomConditioner, PointConditioner, AtomDecoder, noise schedule parameters, and the predict_step lifecycle.

pages.title: Interfaces & Usage
pages.purpose: Overview of all ways to run Emap2lig: CLI, Python API, Web GUI, Agent Skill, and KiharaLab web server. Links to child pages for each interface.

pages.title: CLI Reference
pages.purpose: Complete reference for the emap2lig and fragment-detect commands: required/optional arguments, map normalization flags, examples with EMD-30556 and EMD-7783, and output layout.

pages.title: Input & Output Formats
pages.purpose: Supported cryo-EM map formats (.mrc, .map.gz), ligand list YAML schema (CCD, SMILES, BRANCHED, blob_id), map normalization options, and the full output directory layout including blobs, find_maps, build_struct, and results CSV.

pages.title: Python Programmatic API
pages.purpose: How to call detect_ligand_objects, load_config, parse_ligand_list, and run_structure_modeling directly from Python code, with parameter descriptions and return values.

pages.title: Agent Skill
pages.purpose: Installing and using the agentskills.io emap2lig skill so AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) can guide users through the pipeline.

pages.title: Web GUI
pages.purpose: Overview of the browser-based interface: architecture, startup, four workflow tabs (Setup, Find, Build, Visualization), and the interactive tutorial. Links to backend and frontend child pages.

pages.title: Backend API (FastAPI)
pages.purpose: FastAPI application structure: routers (detect, model, jobs, files, download), Pydantic schemas, service layer (services.py), job state management, progress capture, and GPU detection endpoints.

pages.title: Frontend Components
pages.purpose: React/Vite SPA structure: root App component, Setup tab, FindTab (MUNet detection), BuildTab (diffusion modeling), VisualizationTab, DirPicker, ResultsTable, useJob/useBlobs hooks, and Mol* 3D viewer integration.

pages.title: Model Weights & Licensing
pages.purpose: HuggingFace Hub repository layout, automatic download mechanism, per-model file names and purposes, dual licensing (GPL-3.0 source / academic-only weights), and maintainer update steps.

pages.title: Weight Management
pages.purpose: How weights are downloaded to ~/.emap2lig/models/ via huggingface_hub, check_weights / download_weights / ensure_weights helpers, cache directory configuration, and the Web GUI Setup tab download flow.

pages.title: Development & Testing
pages.purpose: Overview of the development environment, code quality tooling, and test suite. Links to child pages for pre-commit hooks and test infrastructure.

pages.title: Code Quality & Pre-commit Hooks
pages.purpose: Pre-commit pipeline: ruff linting/formatting, pyupgrade, check-yaml/toml/jsonschema, uv-lock synchronization, and GitHub Actions lint workflow.

pages.title: Test Suite
pages.purpose: Test infrastructure: conftest.py fixtures (tmp_ccd_dir, --network flag), test isolation strategy for CCD caching, test_ccd.py and test_layers.py coverage, and the A1CS4.cif fixture.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of all codebase-specific terms, abbreviations, and domain concepts an onboarding engineer needs to know, with code pointers to relevant files and classes.
